headline: Anthropic consolidates Claude products, expands enterprise clinical AI reach
body: Anthropic merged Claude Cowork into its main Claude platform this week, streamlining the product line while the company simultaneously deepens healthcare partnerships. Novo's collaboration with Anthropic to accelerate drug development signals how Claude is positioning itself across the biotech and clinical research pipeline. For healthcare AI implementations, consolidation typically reduces integration complexity in EHR workflows and lowers deployment friction for health systems evaluating multi-modal AI vendors. The expanded enterprise focus matters directly for value-based care organizations considering Claude for clinical documentation, evidence synthesis, and research acceleration. This vendor move will influence how healthcare consulting firms advise clients on LLM platform selection and total cost of ownership.
